question: Working together, A, B and C can do a certain work in 10 days. A is 20% more efficient than B, and C is 50% less efficient than B. B alone can complete the same work in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let B's efficiency be 100 units, therefore

⇒ A : B : C = 120 : 100 : 50

⇒ A + B + C = 270 units

Total work = 270 × 10 = 2700 units

Time taken by B = 2700/100 = 27

**∴ B can do the work in 27 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A, B, and C completed work in 10 days

A is 20% more efficient than B

C is 50% less efficient than B

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B be 100x

The efficiency of A = 100x + 100x × 20%

⇒ 100x + (100x × 20/100) = 120x

The efficiency of C = 100x - 100x × 50%

⇒ 100x - (100x × 50/100) = 50x

Total efficiency = 120x + 100x + 50x = 270x

Total work = 270x × 10 = 2700x

Now, B can do the work = 2700x/100x = 27 days

**∴ B alone can complete the same work in 27 days.**
